evidence: Our use of artificial intelligence (AI) has enabled us to develop new products and marketing more rapidly.
We have started using artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the development and marketing of our products.
This evolving technology presents risks inherent in its use, including risks related to inaccuracies, bias, and infringement of intellectual property.
These risks may become more pronounced as we increase our reliance on AI.
ai_positioning.summary: IPAR utilise l'IA en interne pour accélérer le développement de nouveaux produits et les stratégies marketing, tout en reconnaissant les risques émergents liés à cette technologie en évolution.
